title: Matchday Pilot v2 page spec
description: One spec per page TEMPLATE (not per rendered instance). Declares the page's blocks, each block's backing dbt mart, the i18n keys it uses, and (since #844) its SEO surface, so a build-time checker can refuse to build a page with no spec or a spec that references something that does not exist. TWO checkers read this: scripts/check-page-specs.mjs at prebuild (declaration-time: does everything named here exist?) and scripts/audit-seo.mjs at astro:build:done (output-time: does the EMITTED html match what was declared?). Shape rules are mirrored by hand in check-page-specs.mjs -- keep the two in sync; check-page-specs.test.mjs cross-checks them. See docs/content_architecture.md for the block library.

page.description: The page template's source path, relative to site_v2/src/pages/ (e.g. "[lang]/teams/[team].astro").

entity.description: The entity type this template renders, per docs/content_architecture.md section 2.

stub.description: TRUE only for a page that ships a real URL but has no content blocks yet (a scaffold). It waives the blocks requirement and NOTHING ELSE -- canonical, hreflang and a unique title are true facts about any URL that ships, so the seo block stays required. Every stub must be listed in src/config/indexability.mjs's STUB_PAGES, and the audit refuses to let INDEXABLE become true while that list is non-empty: a stub in the index is a thin page by definition.

block.description: Block name, taken verbatim from the "Block" column of docs/content_architecture.md section 3 -- no new vocabulary.

mart.description: The backing dbt mart model name, e.g. "mart_team_profile" (or an array when one block is genuinely backed by more than one mart). Every value must exist as a real file under dbt_project/models/5_marts/**.

i18n_keys.description: A representative (not required to be exhaustive) sample of i18n keys this block uses, from site_v2/src/i18n/strings.ts. Every LISTED key must exist in the EN dict.

seo.description: The page's organic-search surface, DECLARED here and VERIFIED against the emitted dist/ (#844). CPO ruling: SEO is ensured while the site is built, not audited afterwards -- so no page builds without this block.

canonical.description: "self": the page is its own canonical. Only value today. An alias/variant page pointing elsewhere needs the redirect mechanism (#843/#852) that does not exist yet, so any other value would be a promise nothing keeps.

hreflang.description: "all-locales": one alternate per live locale plus x-default (which points at the en URL, never at the root redirect stub -- see site_architecture.md section 3). "none" only for a page with no locale segment.

title.description: The i18n key holding this page's <title> template, e.g. "seoTeamTitle". Must exist in the EN dict. Being a KEY rather than a literal is what forces the title through t() -- a concatenated title is locale-independent, which is how all three locales shipped byte-identical titles before #844.

description.description: The i18n key holding this page's <meta description> template. Same rule as title. NO NUMBERS until #838: `points` is a synthetic 3-1-0 tally, and a templated figure would write a known-false number into a surface search engines cache independently of the page.

schema_org.description: The schema.org @type this page's JSON-LD entity node must carry (e.g. "SportsTeam"). The audit parses the emitted @graph and fails if the type is absent. Format only -- whether the node is COMPLETE enough for a rich result is a separate content decision per entity.

links.description: The page's place in the internal link graph. SEO is a graph property, not a per-page one: a page nothing links to is a page nothing crawls.

inbound_hub.description: The hub page type expected to link INTO this one (e.g. "competition"). "none" is allowed but is a declared orphan -- say so rather than omit it.

outbound.description: Entity types this page links OUT to. The audit separately proves every emitted internal href resolves to a file the build produced; this declares the intent.

minimum_data.description: What a real entity must have before this page is generated at all (#845). Thin pages shrink crawl budget domain-wide -- 154,644 player pages of near-nothing would cost the whole domain. Free text until #845 settles the threshold, but it must be stated.

page_count_driver.description: A FORMULA over build inputs, not a constant -- the fixture count changes daily. e.g. "teams in src/data/teams/ x locales". The audit gets the real emitted count per route pattern free from astro:build:done's `assets` map and reports it.

url_permanence.description: A DECLARED FACT, not a promise. "permanent": this URL survives its entity's state changes. "ephemeral": it does not, and the reason belongs in url_permanence_note. Declared rather than assumed because fixture URLs are destroyed weeks after kickoff today (#861: only upcoming fixtures are exported), so a gate that simply REFUSED impermanent URLs would have failed the build on the fixture template the day it shipped -- blocking the gate on unrelated work instead of surfacing the defect.

url_permanence_note.description: Required in spirit whenever url_permanence is "ephemeral": what breaks, and which issue fixes it.
